## Why peer review?

+ Feedback makes us better - we should never assume our perspective / work is ultimate
+ Curse of expertise
+ Giving good feedback is a skill (which requires practice)
+ Asking for, receiving, and incorporating feedback is a skill (which requires practice)
+ It's a part of professional life
+ Assessing others' work helps you self-assess and improve your own work
+ Has potential to help your grade! Give the constructive feedback now, before I take points off for it later :) 


**Your task: help them make their project better!** It is NOT helpful or sufficient to say it all looks great. **Don't just critique - give specific suggestions!**

+ ~10 minutes - read over rubric & slides on your own, start taking notes for yourself
+ ~10 minutes - Discuss initial impressions in your groups
    + What do you all think was the main takeaway?
    + Where were people confused? (same spots?)
    + What visualizations came up repeatedly as unclear?
+ ~15 minutes - Fill out feedback form together
+ ~10 minutes - Identify 2-3 specific changes you will make to your own slides
+ ~10 minutes - Debrief
